clips.title: The story
paras: The Twilight's Hammer is a nihilistic, apocalyptic cult dedicated to awakening the Old Gods and bringing about the end of Azeroth. Originally an orcish clan led by the ogre-mage Cho'gall, it has evolved into a secretive, multiracial order actively conducting dark rituals across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

The Twilight's Hammer began on Draenor as an orc clan of the Old Horde, led by the two-headed ogre-mage Cho'gall, one of Gul'dan's chief lieutenants in the Shadow Council. Under Cho'gall the clan embraced a grim, apocalyptic creed, coming to see the Horde as merely an engine of destruction meant to bring about the end of all things.
